summary: Chats from before pull request linking existed get linked too. Once per chat, shortly after launch, the backend reads the chat's stored history through the same loader that opens it (loadConversationHistory: the DB messages plus the Claude and Codex JSONL transcripts) and applies the live auto-link rule (autoLinkRefs) to its user text, assistant text and tool output, so a PR URL pasted by the user or printed by a CLI such as bbpr is linked. Only PRs of the repository the chat's project points at are linked, an unlinked tombstone is never revived, and each PR links once. The scan reads at most the first 250,000 characters of a chat, runs in batches of 50 with two chats at a time and a 25 ms pause between chats, and records each chat it has read in the new conversation_pr_history_scans table so it never reads it again; later messages are the live auto-linker's. 'Find linked PRs in this chat' on a local chat's sidebar context menu re-scans that one chat on demand and says how many PRs it linked and whether the chat was only partly read.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone app does not show chat to PR links yet (they come with the Reviews tab behind mobile_reviews, see reviews-to-chat.json). Links the scan adds are stored on the backend under the chat's root conversation and read through the unchanged pull-requests:links and pull-requests:linked-chats channels, so the Reviews tab will see them with no further change. No manual scan action on the phone.

nativeAndroid.reason: Same as the React Native app: native Android has no linking UI yet (Reviews destination behind native_reviews), and scanned links reach it through the existing pull-requests:links channels. No manual scan action on Android.

updateRelease.reason: One additive channel (pull-requests:history-scan) and one additive table created with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; an older build ignores the table, and a newer build against an older backend only loses the menu action (the invoke fails and the dialog says it could not scan). No package identity, signing, deep-link or update channel change.

automated: tests/unit/pull-request-history-scan.test.ts: a bbpr-style Bitbucket URL in stored tool output links the PR and notifies clients; user text is scanned and a PR of another repository is not linked; a link refused as a tombstone adds nothing and notifies no one; a chat marked scanned is not loaded again; text past 250,000 characters is not read and the result says capped; the pending scan works through every batch and stops rather than loop on a chat that cannot be marked; historyScanSummary wording.
tests/unit/pull-request-links-db.test.ts: marking a chat through a rotated session id records the root conversation, and the unscanned list skips rotated aliases and terminals.
npm run typecheck and npm test green.
notExercised: The background scan and the sidebar menu item were not run in the built app against a real database with pre-linking chats; the scan logic is covered through injected dependencies only.
Memory and main-thread cost of the first scan over a large history (JSONL parsing is synchronous per file); bounded by the batch size, concurrency 2 and the pause between chats, not measured.
